channel.title: HotelHero: Hotel blog
channel.description: Practical UK hotel booking guides: how to compare prices fairly, spot hidden fees and fake discounts, and book smarter across Booking.com, Expedia and more.

item.title: Free cancellation hotel bookings: what your UK rights are and what to check
item.description: Changed your mind on a hotel booking? Citizens Advice says hotel rooms get no 14-day cooling-off. What free cancellation really means and how to check.

item.title: UK visitor levy: what Edinburgh and Wales hotel guests will pay
item.description: Edinburgh's visitor levy is 5% from 24 July 2026 and Wales adds £1.30 a night from April 2027. See what it means for your hotel booking and total price.

item.title: Hidden hotel fees and fake discounts: how to compare prices fairly
item.description: How to compare hotel prices fairly in the UK: spot hidden hotel fees, misleading strikethrough discounts and pressure messages before you book a room.
